validate_scheme: validate a quantization scheme for weights-only PTQ, ensuring dynamic activations and valid weight observer
validate_safetensors_index: validate a safetensors index file for cross-shard fused weight detection in microscale quantization schemes
build_quantization_scheme: build a quantization scheme from a preset name string and validate it for model-free PTQ usage
test_microscale_fused_weights: test for cross-shard fused weight detection by analyzing safetensors index files
review_quantization_observer: review a quantization scheme's weight observer and auto-override minmax or mse to static variants
